description: This file defines types, classes, and functions related to telemetry reporting and test result processing in the Playwright testing framework. It includes classes for managing test suites, test cases, test results, and a receiver for handling JSON-based telemetry events.

classes.name: TeleReporterReceiver
classes.description: Handles telemetry JSON events, manages test suites and test cases, and communicates with a reporter to process test results.

classes.name: TeleSuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, which can contain nested suites and test cases.

classes.name: TeleTestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case with its results, annotations, and metadata.

classes.name: TeleTestStep
classes.description: Represents a step within a test result, including timing, errors, and attachments.

classes.name: TeleTestResult
classes.description: Stores the outcome, timing, attachments, and errors for a test execution.

methods.name: serializeRegexPatterns
methods.description: Converts regex patterns into JsonPattern array format.

methods.name: parseRegexPatterns
methods.description: Parses JsonPattern array back into string or RegExp patterns.

methods.name: computeTestCaseOutcome
methods.description: Determines the overall outcome of a test case based on its results.
